answer: Sable Verification requires real-world activity proof beyond wallet creation. The system tracks behavioral signals like transaction patterns and geographic access points, creating a signature that distinguishes genuine users from automated identities. When the mechanism detects hollow replication of known user behaviors, it flags the account and restricts its influence in the economy. To reach zenith credibility, each verified identity must maintain consistent, diverse activity over time, making it costly for attackers to simulate multiple genuine profiles without raising suspicion.
